text: Five free Claude Code plugins. The first one has 200,000 stars on GitHub.
Number one: Ponytail. It makes Claude write only the code you need. In its own tests: about half the code, a quarter cheaper, same accuracy.
say: Number one: Ponytail. It makes Claude write only the code you need. In its own tests: about half the code, a quarter cheaper, and the same accuracy.

text: Number two: Unslop. It strips the purple gradients and emoji labels from vibe-coded apps, so they look designed.
Number three: Elephant-Goldfish, open-sourced by Google. Fresh reviewers check your plan before any code is written. Google says thousands of its engineers use it every day.
Number four: Agent Reach. Your agent can read YouTube, GitHub and Reddit through your own logins. It never posts.
Number five: Claude Code Setup, from Anthropic. It scans your project and recommends the hooks, skills and MCP servers that fit.
Send this to the friend still using Claude Code with zero plugins.
Comment PLUGINS, and I'll send you all five.
